subject: general
question: In a certain code language, SIXER is coded as 75. How will COLOUR be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Code = Sum of the positional values of the letters**

**SIXER **→

 
• S(19) + I(9) + X(24) + E(5) + R(18) = 19 + 9 + 24 + 5 + 18 = 75

Similarly,

**COLOUR →**

 
• C(3) + O(15) + L(12) + O(15) + U(21) + R(18) = 3 + 15 + 12 + 15 + 21 + 18 = **84**

Hence, **‘COLOUR’** will be written as **“84”.**
